request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Replace the one big black rocket with a tight bundle of five small fireworks rockets of different sizes on thin wooden sticks, standing up in the cart and leaning forward, tied with pale rope: paper tubes in grubby red, orange, yellow, one blue and one green, each with a cream paper cone tip and a short fuse, one fuse lit with a spark. The little goblin gets green skin and an orange-brown leather cap. Keep the wooden cart, wheels, goblin, black outline and art style.
